info.title: SignRelay.Cli
info.description: CLI tool for SignRelay — submit files to a relay server, wait for signing via SSE, and download signed outputs. Keeps code-signing keys off the CI runner.

commands.name: submit
commands.description: Submit files to the relay, wait for signing, then download signed outputs.

options.name: --server
options.description: Base URL of the SignRelay server (e.g. https://relay.example.com)

options.name: --output
options.description: Write signed files under this directory (preserves relative paths).

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite input files with signed copies. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum time to wait for signing to complete. [default: 00:45:00]

options.name: --allow-insecure
options.description: Allow http:// server URLs (not recommended; bearer tokens will be sent in cleartext). [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate arguments and resolve input files, print the job manifest, then exit without contacting the server. [default: False]
